If you do not agree to the %1$s, we can only provide you with basic services: message reception and notifications, message sending, contact matching for message content, calling via messages, and ensuring your secure usage. In basic mode, this app requires internet connection and access to media data (photos).\n\nEntering basic mode requires collecting some necessary personal information from you. You may refer to the \'How We Collect and Use Your Personal Information\' section in the %2$s to understand the types and purposes of personal information we collect and use. Please rest assured that choosing to enter basic mode does not mean you agree to all contents of the Privacy Policy.

This app requires an internet connection, access to media and audio-visual data, and reading of the device\'s unique identifiers (IMEI, IMSI, Device ID) for the purposes of viewing, storing, and managing SMS/MMS, as well as identifying the senders and recipients of SMS messages. During usage, we will collect location information, enable local recording, activate camera photo-taking/recording functions, retrieve the list of installed applications, and access contact book data. These data are used to send location information or nearby mini-programs when creating new conversations, deliver voice messages, enable the QR code scanning function, determine whether the app is running in the foreground, and display contact information corresponding to the phone numbers of incoming messages.The aforementioned collection and use of personal information will only be triggered when specific business functions are in use.\n\nPlease read the %1$s and %2$s to learn more about our rules for processing your personal information, and read the %3$s to understand your rights and obligations. Clicking \"Agree\" indicates that you consent to all the above content.
